heading: About
paragraphs: I write backend systems and the interfaces that sit on them. Most of my time goes to retrieval pipelines: getting a model to answer from a specific set of documents instead of from whatever it remembers.

Transinaut is the one that pays rent on its own server. I designed it, built it and shipped it alone, and it has been classifying customs codes for freight forwarders since early 2026. Chronicler, my final-year project, does the same trick offline for companies that cannot send a contract to a cloud API.
I am in the first year of a Master's in Information Systems Engineering and AI at ESISA in Fez, and I am looking for a software development internship.
